checks.instruction: Run npm.cmd test from this worktree. Every test suite must pass.
Run npm.cmd run build from this worktree. TypeScript and the Vite production build must succeed.

Serve this worktree's production build with npm.cmd run preview on a dedicated port. Inspect changed UI in a browser at desktop and mobile widths for images, layout, keyboard controls and relevant interactions. For rollback, inspect the restored affected screen. Follow the applicable UI_GUIDELINES.md.
